BETA Close X Serco Group PLC has announced the purchase of 1,371,442 ordinary shares on 11 May 2026 for an average price of 269.66 pence per share, 273,104 shares on 12 May 2026 at an average of 264.90 pence, 259,531 shares on 13 May 2026 at an average of 266.58 pence, 280,000 shares on 14 May 2026 at an average of 268.44 pence, and 278,667 shares on 15 May 2026 at an average of 266.36 pence, as part of its ongoing share buyback program. Following these transactions, the company's total issued ordinary shares, excluding treasury shares, stand at 990,806,729, with 11,939,285 shares held in treasury. The total number of voting rights is now 990,806,729. Disclaimer* Serco Group PLC 15 May 2026 15 May 2026 Legal Entity Identifier: 549300PT2CIHYN5GWJ21 Serco Group plc Transactions in own shares Serco Group plc (the " Company ") announces that, in accordance with the terms of its share buyback programme (the " Programme ") announced on 5 March 2026, it has purchased the following number of its ordinary shares of 2 pence each (" Ordinary Shares ") through RBC Europe Limited. Date of purchase: Number of Ordinary Shares purchased: Average price paid per Share (pence): Lowest price paid per Share (pence): Highest price paid per Share (pence): 11 May 2026 280,000 269.6595 267.0000 271.0000 12 May 2026 273,104 264.9036 263.4000 274.8000 13 May 2026 259,531 266.5809 264.6000 268.4000 14 May 2026 280,000 268.4390 267.2000 269.6000 15 May 2026 278,667 266.3576 263.8000 269.4000 Following the above transactions, the Company will have 990,806,729 Ordinary Shares in issue (excluding treasury shares). The total number of Ordinary Shares held in treasury is 11,939,285 . The total number of voting rights in the Company, excluding treasury shares as at 15 May 2026 is 990,806,729 . This figure may be used by shareholders (and others with notification obligations) as the denominator for the calculations by which they will determine if they are required to notify their interest in, or a change to their interest in, Company or its Group under the Financial Conduct Authority's Disclosure Guidance and Transparency Rules. Since the announcement of the Programme on 5 March 2026, the Company has purchased a total of 11,939,285 Ordinary Shares, which are held in treasury.
